title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
summary: Find the length of the shortest run of positive numbers whose sum reaches a target.

tests.explain: [2, 7] sums to exactly 9. No single value reaches 9, so the answer is 2.
Even the whole array only sums to 3, so no subarray works: return 0.
The single value 4 already reaches the target.

hints: All numbers are positive: adding an element makes a sum bigger, removing one makes it smaller.
Grow a window to the right until its sum reaches the target. That window is valid, but maybe not the shortest ending here.
While the sum is still at least the target, record the length and shrink from the left. Return 0 if nothing was ever recorded.

complexity.time: O(n): left and right each move forward at most n times
